details.method: Before acknowledging a new content-addressed reference, validate existing deduplicated bytes or retain a verified immutable storage guarantee; mismatch rejects the entire transaction.
details.when: Content-addressed persistence reuses an existing digest row and durable success implies new references are readable.
details.counterexample: A claimed digest does not establish healthy stored bytes. Full byte verification may be too expensive for streaming assets; equivalent immutable-object validation needs its own evidence.
details.trial_plan: In a future consumer integration, corrupt an existing object, submit a multi-object batch that reuses it, assert no new heads or receipts, recover explicitly, then replay the same request and read every object.
